# Josh Schwartz | Humber Bay Shores & South Etobicoke Realtor

> Josh Schwartz is a Sales Representative with Snobar Realty Group Inc., Brokerage. He works with Thapar Team for marketing and client support. RECO Registration No. 4781243. Primary focus: Humber Bay Shores, Mimico, and South Etobicoke.

## Brokerage vs team
- Brokerage of record: Snobar Realty Group Inc., Brokerage
- Team affiliation: Thapar Team (marketing / credential network; not a substitute for the brokerage)

## Services
- Buying: local market briefs, home matching, first-time buyer guidance, mortgage introductions, negotiation
- Selling: pricing from comparable sales, MLS and social marketing, offer negotiation
- Leasing: rent guidance, tenant screening support, lease negotiation for landlords and tenants

## Service areas
Humber Bay Shores, Mimico, South Etobicoke, Etobicoke, Toronto, North York, Markham, Richmond Hill, Vaughan, Mississauga, and the Greater Toronto Area (GTA).
